review.method: Compared each target to all non-null source rows in the complete three UI categories; checked paired control descriptions and all four flight-mode variants. Preserved each icon and double-tap marker. No character names introduced.
terminology: Controls, Shift, Select, Ascend and Descend match existing translated setup and controller diagrams.
Easy Rev. and Flight Rev. abbreviate reversed vertical input, stated explicitly in their help.
Invert Y and Invert X/Y mean vertical-only and vertical-plus-horizontal camera inversion respectively.
Slide left/right (rudder) retains both horizontal movement and the original rudder terminology.
uncertainties: Flight Type means the flight control scheme, not a different unit transformation.
The compact Forward/back line inherits Left stick from the immediately preceding line; no specific up-versus-down mapping is invented for normal Flight mode.
review.fit_status: All 74 targets pass font 2500 character coverage after native aliases. Flight help character counts are 208/216/192/194 and maximum native-font line widths are 373/330/339/354 (original 373/405/339/332). Longest controller footer is 533 units. Renderer capacity, actual widget geometry and in-game layout remain the builder responsibility.
